svg.title: AC⚡DC Architecture (specs5)
svg.desc: Layered architecture diagram derived from specs5: Foundation → Indexing → Engine → Features → Webapp, with Deployment and Future layers. A single Python process exposes jrpc-oo over WebSocket to a Lit browser client and drives one Claude Code session through the Claude Agent SDK; the claude CLI runs as an external subprocess owned by the SDK client.
svg.text: Browser frontend for Claude Code · single Python process · bidirectional JSON-RPC over WebSocket (jrpc-oo) · per-repo .ac-dc4/ working dir

g.text: Speculative; nothing in any other layer depends on this one.
Shell owns the single WebSocket; tabs and viewers share one RPC proxy via a mixin. All traffic goes through the transport, never to a component directly.
Compose the engine, repo, and index layers. Doc Convert depends only on Foundation. URL fetching is retired — the agent has WebFetch and WebSearch.
paste · store · reattach · verbatim content blocks
clean-tree gate · merge-base · soft reset · diffs
No prompt assembly, no token budget, no cache tiering. Frame a turn, pump the stream, gate the tools, mirror the transcript.
Consistent snapshots within a tool call, flushed before any ac-dc tool answers. Consumers: Monaco language features · MCP bridge · browser navigation.
No dependencies; everything above builds on these.
Vite build · static server · per-platform packaging (the SDK bundles a ~295 MB CLI) · startup phases · graceful shutdown
